description: What a producer MACHINE can do — the keys a machine-model declaration writes so a product's requirement profile can be matched against it. Deliberately distinct from the `capabilities` vocabulary, which holds Fashion Cabinet's garment-feature flags: the two share a word and nothing else, and the lane refuses a key that appears in both.

review.note: Key set, cross-maps, labels and definitions drafted in one pass by an agent (P3-LEX lane, 2026-10-02) against SEM-1 §4. No language facet of any entry has had a native review: every entry says `generated`, and Spanish is the bar a reviewer should read first. Facts were checked against the cited sources on the access date; no ruling has been made by a human.

definition.en: Highest nozzle temperature the machine is rated for, in °C.
definition.es: Temperatura de boquilla más alta para la que está especificada la máquina, en °C.
definition.fr: Température de buse la plus élevée pour laquelle la machine est spécifiée, en °C.

definition.en: Whether the build volume is enclosed, holding heat and fumes around the part.
definition.es: Si el volumen de impresión está cerrado y retiene calor y vapores alrededor de la pieza.

definition.pt: Se o volume de impressão é fechado, retendo calor e fumos em volta da peça.

definition.en: Whether the enclosure is actively heated, not merely warmed by the bed.
definition.es: Si la cámara se calienta de forma activa y no solo por el calor de la cama.

definition.pt: Se a câmara é aquecida ativamente, e não apenas pelo calor da mesa.

definition.pt: Número de cabeçotes ou hotends independentes que podem imprimir no mesmo trabalho.

definition.en: Number of materials loaded at once and selectable without operator action (e.g. spools in an automatic material system).

definition.pt: Número de materiais carregados ao mesmo tempo e selecionáveis sem intervenção do operador (p. ex. bobinas num sistema automático de materiais).
